review.notes: All 62 physical pages were diffed as extracted text against the OCR markdown with normalization for LaTeX-equivalent math, quotes, hyphenation and HTML entities, and the heading/fence structure was scanned globally (no code fences; the only caption promoted to a heading is repaired below). Physical pages 1, 6, 17, 20, 37, 38, 44, 45 and 46 were rendered (100-300 dpi) and visually inspected for the confirmed repairs. Remaining normalized diffs are task-instruction banners, legends and dialogues inside embedded figures, plus flattened progress-score table cells whose values spot-check correctly against the rendered pages; per-cell verification of every score table and an exhaustive spaced-digit sweep were not completed within this review.
